source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第六节

textbook_summary: typeII SA block loses P-QRS-T with integer-multiple long PP.
implementation_basis: Existing authored fixed perfusion inputs, not clinical calibration
invariants: Recovery on original baseline sinus grid after exact doubled PP
Dropped P-QRS-T and no new mechanical input; preceding repolarization completes
CVP cardiac components and Resp artifact follow surviving beats
Indexed bounded lookup, recovery and atomic configuration
limitations: Fixed second-degree typeII example only; no first-degree or third-degree inference
No sinus-node potential or conduction mechanism
No first escape or RR-dependent pump calibration
